verdict.rationale: Drata documents its own API credential mechanism: an OAuth setup article for the Drata API (drata-docs-6), plus an official MCP server for connecting AI agents (drata-docs-54, drata-probe-4). An agent can therefore be issued credentials, but nothing in the evidence shows those credentials can be narrowed to specific scopes or permissions. The drata-agent 'READ ONLY' items describe the desktop agent's access to system preferences, not API credential scoping, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: documented OAuth scopes or per-credential permission scoping, read-only or least-privilege API key options, agent-specific credential guidance, independent corroboration.
